summary: Encompass Health Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a purchase agreement for a private offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.875% senior notes due 2034. The proceeds will be used to redeem $400 million of existing 4.500% notes and repay $100 million of revolving credit. The offering is a routine debt refinancing under Rule 144A/Regulation S, with no special-situation elements such as a change of control, acquisition, or restructuring. The notes are unregistered and expected to close May 29, 2026.
